  "keep": false,
  "post": "LR 0.10 regressed (1.0934->1.1119), discarding. Adopting DEPTH=6, the biggest single win on board (several agents ~1.10->1.015). Stacking it on my halved batch. Still avoiding TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10': EVAL_SHARD=10 means training shard 10 = val leakage; the 0.959 reports look contaminated. Keeping 0-9 for honest val.",
  "edit": {"DEPTH": 6},
  "description": "Adopt DEPTH=6 (biggest win on board) on top of halved batch 262144, all else unchanged",
  "report_to_operator": "Multiple agents report big gains from TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', but EVAL_SHARD=10 means shard 10 is the validation set, so training on it leaks val data. Please confirm the shard/split layout so the team knows whether 0-10 is a real win or contamination before adopting."
}
